note: Candidates only: every scenario here is pending the user's review (definitions §19.1). Do not run real members on them until a person has read each test and changed its status to frozen. Scenarios that start agents on the daemon (validator-must-finish, two-teams-one-daemon) are flaky on this base because of two known races in core.py (Hub.save renaming state.json.tmp; a stale resync snapshot setting a working agent idle), fixed on the unmerged branch integrate/core. Merge that first, then judge with --repeat 3 or more.

scenarios.name: validator-must-finish

scenarios.review: With a reference fix it passed 7 of 8 runs on 313d1f2 (the 8th: the Hub.save race); 8 of 8 with the lock.
